per_source_meaning.name: aspnet-core
per_source_meaning.meaning: Respect actual target framework and existing app model; host/DI/middleware/auth/state and integration testing are task-specific. Select a focused reference rather than loading all, but unread referenced chapters are not accepted copies.
per_source_meaning.changes: No default switch to .NET10 from March2026 text; check actual pinned SDK/current official docs when used. Keep new defaultGo/GoDDRust and existing application language. No arbitrary app-model rewrite/new product name.

per_source_meaning.name: chatgpt-apps
per_source_meaning.meaning: Plan tool schemas and effects before bridge/UI; separate concise structuredContent, narration and widget payload; validate target MCP contract, annotations, retries, resource version/CSP and host state. Current documented APIs must be checked at implementation time.
per_source_meaning.changes: Hints are not authorization or server-side validation; widget-only data is still client-accessible and must not contain secrets. Do not automatically run Node/Python scaffold, add permanent MCP access, tunnel/deploy or submit. ExistingOAuth only, source examples are not current API compatibility proof, UI same-image approval required.

per_source_meaning.name: linear
per_source_meaning.meaning: Bind workspace/team/project/issue identifiers, read relevant state then batch authorized updates and read back. Missing search results may be archived/pagination/access rather than absence; preserve bulk grouping and retry/duplicate identity.
per_source_meaning.changes: No automatic mcp add/config/WSL/npx setup, blanket cookie clearing or ownerPC restart instruction. Tools only when actually available under existing integration and task scope. Sending comments/messages requires explicit task authorization; stale status alone is not authorization.

per_source_meaning.name: security-ownership-map
per_source_meaning.meaning: Git people/file and cochange graphs can indicate concentrated historical knowledge; define window/ref/author-vs-committer/date/merge/bot/large-commit filters, denominators and recency. Compare CODEOWNERS with observed history without treating touches or cochange as responsibility or access proof.
per_source_meaning.changes: Keep CI/lock/glue sensitivity where relevant, inspect shallow history/renames/aliases and exclusions. Timezone offset is not a location/identity fact. Bound outputs and do not export raw personal identities or private source names outside authorized scope. No Python installer/networkx/Neo4j execution from this source.

per_source_meaning.name: security-threat-model
per_source_meaning.meaning: Ground entrypoints, assets, trust edges, attacker capabilities and abuse paths in actual repo evidence; separate runtime from CI/dev, observed controls from proposals, and impact/likelihood from assumptions. Carry unresolved conditions into priority.
per_source_meaning.changes: Do not universally pause for1..3user confirmations or impose a threat count cap. Investigate technical assumptions independently; only missing owner-only requirements are asked once using saved decisions. Do not invent template output, components, exploit success or customer rights from unread companions.

per_source_meaning.name: winui-app
per_source_meaning.meaning: Separate environment readiness, actual packaging model/build artifact, responsive top-level-window behavior, input/theme/accessibility and owned process lifecycle. Choose actual target-version controls and evidence rather than assuming a launcher exit proves startup.
per_source_meaning.changes: No invented PascalCase product names, unreviewed config/winget bootstrapping or pinned unsupported template flags. Verify installed version/source, use normalquietCLI/AdminBroker and allocated resources. Same-image approval precedesUI implementation; close own verification app unless owner asked to keep delivery. No backend language policy override.
